_comment: Перевод relics.json на en. Числа и правила остаются в исходнике; здесь только строки. Строка, совпадающая с русской, считается непереведённой — см. tool/l10n.dart --check.

ash_covenant.name: Ashen Covenant
ash_covenant.text: Burning can crit and stacks up to five times. Direct Fire damage −50%.

blood_oath_ring.name: Blood Oath
blood_oath_ring.text: Only leech heals you — no rest, no regeneration. Life leech ×3.

boots_of_descent.name: Boots of the Descent
boots_of_descent.text: One wave fewer per floor. Gold and items of common and uncommon rarity are not picked up.

charm_of_silence.name: Charm of Silence
charm_of_silence.text: Every ability slot holds two passive abilities. Active abilities are unavailable.

counter_of_moments.name: Counter of Moments
counter_of_moments.text: All counted effects trigger twice as often. Critical strikes are unavailable.

crown_of_obsession.name: Crown of Obsession
crown_of_obsession.text: Only one active ability is available. Its cooldown is −70% and it strikes the whole wave.

ember_conduit.name: Ember Conduit
ember_conduit.text: All damage becomes Fire, +30%. Fire resistance −50.

endless_censer.name: Endless Censer
endless_censer.text: Abilities cost no mana. Cooldowns take twice as long.

first_blood_gauntlet.name: Gauntlet of First Blood
first_blood_gauntlet.text: The first hit on a wave is three times stronger. Every hit after it is −25%.

hide_of_prisms.name: Hide of Prisms
hide_of_prisms.text: Armor does not work at all. +45 to all resistances.

horn_of_the_hunt.name: Horn of the Hunt
horn_of_the_hunt.text: Bosses give twice as much. Every other enemy has +35% HP.

mask_of_certainty.name: Mask of Certainty
mask_of_certainty.text: Every hit is a critical strike. Base damage −45%.

reaper_edge.name: Reaper's Edge
reaper_edge.text: An enemy below 18% health dies instantly. Damage −30%.

rime_conduit.name: Rime Conduit
rime_conduit.text: All damage becomes Cold, +30%. Cold resistance −50.

rope_of_the_deep.name: Rope of the Deep
rope_of_the_deep.text: The descent starts 10 floors deeper. Maximum HP −30%.

scarred_pact.name: Scarred Pact
scarred_pact.text: Every hit you take grants +5% damage until the end of the wave, up to eight times.

seal_of_haste.name: Seal of Haste
seal_of_haste.text: Cooldowns are half as long. Mana costs twice as much.

seal_of_thousand_eyes.name: Seal of a Thousand Eyes
seal_of_thousand_eyes.text: Curses last until the end of the floor and carry over to new waves. Damage to uncursed enemies −60%.

skin_of_despair.name: Skin of Despair
skin_of_despair.text: Maximum HP −65%. Effects conditioned on being below X% HP are always active. Life leech doubled.

split_counterweight.name: Split Counterweight
split_counterweight.text: Two-handed weapons can be held in one hand. Maximum HP −40%.

storm_conduit.name: Storm Conduit
storm_conduit.text: All damage becomes Lightning, +30%. Lightning resistance −50.

tireless_boots.name: Tireless Boots
tireless_boots.text: The mercenary does not rest between floors. One wave fewer per floor.

twin_rings.name: Twin Rings
twin_rings.text: Both rings give double. The amulet does not work.

void_conduit.name: Void Conduit
void_conduit.text: All damage becomes Void, +30%. Void resistance −50.
